contracts.commit_point: The ADK before_tool_callback invocation immediately before the MCP write tool executes — the point at which returning the cancellation dict substitutes for the tool result and prevents the write from being dispatched to the MCP server (mechanism declared at confirmation.py:9-13; hook wired at agent.py:89-91).
contracts.declared_mechanism: LlmAgent(root_agent) registers confirm_before_write as before_tool_callback (agent.py:89-91). The callback classifies tools via is_write_tool — substring match on WRITE_TOOL_MARKERS minus SAFE_TOOL_NAMES (confirmation.py:28-38, 41-56, 59-64) — prints a plain-English summary of the pending write (confirmation.py:96-98, 67-84), and per the declared ADK contract (return None -> tool runs; return dict -> tool skipped with that dict as result, confirmation.py:9-13) returns None only on 'y'/'yes', otherwise returns {"status": "cancelled", "reason": ...}; EOFError is treated as 'n' (confirmation.py:107-120). OUTREACH_AUTO_CONFIRM=1/true/yes auto-confirms and bypasses the prompt, off by default (confirmation.py:101-105).
contracts.forbidden_condition: A tool call classified as a MongoDB write (lowercased name matching a WRITE_TOOL_MARKER and not exempted by SAFE_TOOL_NAMES) proceeding to execution at the agent's tool dispatch without an explicit interactive 'y'/'yes' answer — i.e., the callback returning None for a classified write without user consent, or the write proceeding after the user declined or input hit EOF.
pending_binding_information: The concrete tool names exposed by mongodb-mcp-server@latest are not in the supplied source; whether every write tool name matches a marker (and no write name is exempted by SAFE_TOOL_NAMES or lacks a marker) cannot be confirmed from the supplied views.
The ADK framework source implementing before_tool_callback (None proceeds / dict skips) is not supplied; the skip semantics rests on the docstring declaration at confirmation.py:9-13.
Entry-point wiring for 'adk run', 'adk web', and main.py is not supplied; whether input() at confirmation.py:108 is connected to a human in every launch mode is unverified.
Deployment/CI configuration for OUTREACH_AUTO_CONFIRM is not supplied.
contracts.protected_operation: Agent-dispatched invocations of MongoDB MCP write tools against the Atlas cluster reached via settings.mongo_connection_string (passed as MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_STRING to the npx-launched mongodb-mcp-server).
contracts.protected_resource: MongoDB databases and collections on the configured Atlas cluster (the database/collection/payload arguments of the write tool call).
contracts.protection_obligation: Merged from both reviewers: MongoDB write tool calls (insert/update/delete/drop/rename/create-collection/create-index/bulk/replace, and any tool name matching a write marker) routed through the root_agent LlmAgent's MongoDB MCP toolset must be blocked from executing until the human user explicitly confirms with 'y'/'yes' in the registered before_tool_callback confirm_before_write, which runs immediately before tool execution; unconfirmed writes are skipped via a cancellation dict result instead of None, with EOF fail-closing to denial.
scope_limits: Gating is keyed on tool-name substrings (confirmation.py:28-38, 59-64); reads (find, aggregate, count, list-databases, list-collections, collection-schema, collection-indexes, db-stats, explain) and the four custom Python tools (load_seed_leads, fetch_live_leads, score_lead, draft_message) are explicitly exempt via SAFE_TOOL_NAMES (confirmation.py:41-56).

OUTREACH_AUTO_CONFIRM set to 1/true/yes auto-confirms every gated write, bypassing the interactive prompt (confirmation.py:101-105); the default is empty/off (confirmation.py:103). Per the second reviewer this is an explicit, off-by-default automation mode that does not negate the default guard.
The gate is a blocking interactive stdin prompt inside the callback process (confirmation.py:108); only entry points that attach a human to that stdin provide the confirmation channel.
The dict-return-skips-tool semantics is the ADK contract as documented in the module docstring (confirmation.py:9-13); the ADK framework itself is not in the supplied source views.

The two reviewer opinions describe the same obligation and mechanism and have been merged into this single contract; no obligation here covers non-MongoDB effects (e.g., the npx child-process launch or the custom function tools).

Entry-point sources (adk CLI runner, adk web server, main.py) showing whether interactive stdin is attached to the callback's input() prompt in every launch mode.
